tasks.prompt: Write the first Hard set once each, saying each aloud (~2 min): ぎ げ やま よる ひがし. Then the second Hard set: ざ ず ぞ かぜ (also still Hard). Then read the 5 lines twice, slow then normal speed. Watch the two dots on ぎ げ ざ ず ぞ.
tasks.script:
ぎ gi · げ ge · やま yama · よる yoru · ひがし higashi
ざ za · ず zu · ぞ zo · かぜ kaze
かぎ (kagi)
ひがし (higashi)
よる の やま (yoru no yama)
かぜ が つよい (kaze ga tsuyoi)
じかん が ない (jikan ga nai)

questions.explain: ぎ = き plus two dots (dakuten). げ is ge.
やま yama = mountain 山. よる is night; かぎ is key.
よ yo + る ru = よる.
か ka + ぎ gi = かぎ. Remember the two dots on ぎ.
ひがし higashi = east 东. かぜ is wind.
